text: Warm, welcoming, and rich in classic San Francisco character, this four-bedroom, two-bath home blends beautiful period details with generous living spaces and an expansive, park-like backyard in the heart of West Portal. Freshly refinished hardwood floors and newly painted interiors complement the home's architectural charm. The gracious living room features a vaulted ceiling, a Batchelder-tiled fireplace with a wood-burning insert, and floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the space with natural light. An adjoining formal dining room opens to a side patio, creating an inviting setting for gatherings. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers abundant cabinetry and counter space for everyday cooking and entertaining. Two bedrooms and a split bathroom complete the main level. Downstairs, two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or creative pursuits. A generous deck opens to the deep, terraced garden, where multiple levels provide inviting spaces for outdoor dining, gardening, and quiet relaxation. The oversized garage features high ceilings, two-car parking, laundry, and ample additional space for storage or a workshop. Just a few blocks from West Portal Village's cafs, restaurants, shops, library, playground, and Muni service, this charming home also enjoys proximity to Stern Grove and convenient access to 19th Avenue and major freeways.

agent: Sotheby's International Realty - San Francisco Brokerage
text: Inviting three-bed, two-bath Golden Gate Heights home with a great floor plan inside and just as much to offer outside! The main level upstairs features a spacious living room with fireplace and new deck. The dining room is open to both the living room and the kitchen, all with views of Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower. A well-appointed, updated kitchen has a large island, stainless steel appliances, abundant custom cabinets and a skylight. Two well-sized bedrooms and a fully-remodeled bath with a separate tub and walk-in shower complete the upper floor. On the permitted lower floor is a third bedroom, remodeled bath, internal access to the back garden through a central hallway, separate office, and plenty of closets. The one-car garage, accessed internally from the lower level, includes laundry and storage. The long lot includes a lower deck, brick patio, two flat levels of turf and lawn, planting beds, mature flora and citrus trees. There is also a charming detached studio perfect for a yoga room, children's playhouse, or atelier. Brand new roof and back decks completed with permits. Newly painted inside and out, new light fixtures throughout, and new sidewalk.

Renovated top floor 1BR/1BA Plus office with ocean views in a 4 unit building in the Inner Sunset. Garage parking, steps away to Irving restaurants and nearby Golden Gate Park. Large windows in both the front and back of the home offer great light all day, including big ocean views. Renovated kitchen equipped with dishwasher, quartz countertops, electric stove and oven, power vent hood, microwave, full-sized fridge and solar tunnel lighting. The bathroom features a walk-in shower with dual head faucets, custom tile work and skylight. Spacious bedroom is currently utilized as a second living space, office and craft area to capture the afternoon light and expansive ocean views. As a bedroom, it offers enough room for a king-sized bed and desk plus oversized closet. The den or office space is currently used as a cozy bedroom, and has sliders for privacy. Multiple closets, and great storage in the home, plus additional storage in the garage and building. One car deeded parking in garage, laundry and back yard perfect for gardening and grilling! Walking distance to excellent dining options like Tartine, Fiorela, San Tung, Rose Indian, Arizmendi bakery, new hot spots including Maggie and Mac's, and Gregoire's. Close proximity to Golden Gate Park, Muni lines and UCSF Parnassus Campus expansion which is investing in infrastructure, and predicted to provide long term stability and growth for property values.

address: 829 Broderick St Apt 1, San Francisco, CA
text: Rich in architectural character and enhanced by modern updates, 829 Broderick Street #1 offers the warmth and charm of a classic San Francisco flat in a desirable NoPa location. This spacious studio makes the perfect starter home or pied-a-terre and combines high ceilings, wood floors, and thoughtful improvements to provide modern comfort and convenience. The large eat-in kitchen features newly installed cabinetry, contemporary finishes, stainless steel appliances, and ample room for dining. The functional layout includes the convenience of in-unit laundry. Throughout the home, modern updates blend seamlessly with preserved architectural details, offering the best of both old and new San Francisco. Light from the traditional bay windows fills the main room with light. The updated bath features a flexible shower-over-tub with glass surround. A dedicated storage space is also included! Ideally situated in the heart of North Panhandle, just moments from Golden Gate Park's Panhandle, Divisadero Street's popular cafes and restaurants, neighborhood shops, and convenient transit, this move-in-ready residence offers the very best of NoPa living!

Discover the charm of Westwood Park living in this inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bath home, ideally situated just one block from Ocean Avenue's vibrant mix of neighborhood cafes, restaurants, shops, and Whole Foods. Thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home features an inviting living room with a fireplace, an adjoining dining room, and a centrally located kitchen that connects the living spaces. The primary suite opens directly to a beautifully landscaped, private backyard, creating a peaceful retreat perfect for morning coffee, gardening, or alfresco gatherings. Two additional spacious bedrooms and a second full bath offer flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. One-car garage plus additional off-street parking, a dedicated laundry room, and convenient access to public transportation add to the home's everyday appeal. Combining comfort, charm, and an exceptional neighborhood location, this is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the best of San Francisco's beloved Westwood Park.

address: 1027 Rhode Island St, San Francisco, CA
text: Enjoy Potrero Hill living in this charming home with western and southern city views, classic architectural details, and a versatile multi-level floor plan. The main level features two street-facing bedrooms with city views, a beautifully renovated bathroom with soaring ceilings and skylight & an inviting living room with an adjacent dining room. The spacious kitchen offers modern appliances, a peninsula with seating, an adjoining casual dining are and laundry closet. A flat rear yard and expansive deck offer easy indoor-outdoor living. There is an upper attic suite with additional city views, skylights, and a spacious bathroom with a soaking tub. The lower level offers a guest space with a separate entrance, kitchenette, and bathroom. Interior stairs connect this level to the main residence, offering flexibility for a variety of uses. A separate basement storage area and dedicated workshop room add exceptional utility. A one-car garage completes the home. Enjoy convenient access to restaurants, cafs, and shops along 18th Street, plus nearby Whole Foods Market. Explore Dogpatch, catch events at Chase Center, and reach UCSF Mission Bay with ease. Nearby Muni, Caltrain, BART, and Highways 101 and 280 provide connections throughout San Francisco, the Peninsula, SFO, and the greater Bay Area.

Prime Parkside Sunset location. Spacious Doelger styled tunnel entry home featuring 2 bedrooms plus a large sunroom with en-suite bathroom and great views. There is an additional full bathroom with a separate shower stall, living room, corner fireplace, eat in kitchen with new quartz countertop, new electromagnetic induction cooktop and a formal dining room on the main level. There is a finished bonus room, two car tandem garage, abundant storage space, laundry area and a large leveled yard on the lower level. Newly painted inside and out, refinished hardwood floors, new double pane windows, crown molding and skylights throughout. Property to be sold as is condition. Located a block away from vibrant Noriega St and from transportation.

Welcome to 175 Rae Avenue, an extraordinary San Francisco residence offering a rare combination of space, flexibility, and thoughtful design. With approximately 5,390 square feet of living space, 8 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms, this expansive home provides room to grow, gather, entertain, work, and create a lifestyle entirely your own.Designed across multiple levels, the home offers an exceptional sense of privacy and versatility ideal for multigenerational living, extended family, guests, home offices, or simply those who want the luxury of having more space. Generous living areas with multiple wet bars and bathrooms on each level to function comfortably on its own while still feeling connected as one impressive residence. Natural light fills the interiors through dual-pane windows and skylights, highlighting beautiful walnut hardwood floors, detailed crown molding, recessed lighting, and thoughtfully updated finishes. The kitchens feature quartz countertops, designer cabinetry, stylish backsplashes, stainless steel appliances, and breakfast bars that invite both everyday living and effortless entertaining. The spacious bedrooms provide peaceful retreats, while five updated bathrooms including primary suites with spa-style tubs bring comfort and relaxation to everyday life. Outside, an oversized redwood deck and patio create a wonderful extension of the living space, perfect for weekend gatherings, outdoor dining, or simply enjoying a quiet afternoon at home. An attached two-car garage adds convenience rarely found with a residence of this scale. Set in San Francisco's Outer Mission neighborhood, 175 Rae Avenue places you close to the shops, restaurants, neighborhood businesses, and public transportation along Mission Street, while offering easy access to I-280 for quick connections throughout the city and down the Peninsula. Nearby transit links provide convenient access toward Balboa Park BART, while CCSF and SFSU are just minutes away. It is a location that lets you enjoy the best of both worlds the character and convenience of San Francisco with excellent connectivity to the Peninsula, SFO, and surrounding communities. Homes with this combination of scale, flexibility, outdoor space, parking, and location simply do not come along often. More than a home, this home is an opportunity to create a place where generations can come together, guests always have room to stay, and life's biggest moments have the space they deserve.

Set in distinguished Merced Manor, this gracious Spanish Revival home makes a memorable first impression with red barrel tiles, tall arched windows, and ornamental ironwork. Its 3-level layout offers expansive living spaces, 2 bedrooms, and a full bath on the main floor; 2 bedrooms and a full bath upstairs; and a family/entertaining area, bonus bath, and garage at ground level. Front stairs lead to a sheltered porch and foyer with patterned hardwood floors. Through a broad archway, the living room features dark wood beams accentuating a vaulted ceiling, with a sculpted fireplace anchoring the room. A tall arched window frames a view toward the Mount Davidson Cross, while windows on 2 sides fill the room with natural light. In the formal dining room, soft lighting around a ceiling dome creates a warm evening glow. A sunny breakfast room with built-in buffet connects to the kitchen, where updated cabinetry, new countertops, and stainless steel appliances complement vintage tilework. The 2 generously sized main-floor bedrooms feature bay windows, built-in cabinetry, and ample closet space. A naturally lit dressing area opens to the full bath. Upstairs, a skylit stairwell leads to 2 spacious bedrooms with sweeping views across red-tiled rooftops to the Pacific Ocean. Walk-in closets provide generous storage, while a second dressing area features built-in cabinetry and a vanity. A full bathroom serves this level. Downstairs, an expansive wood-paneled family/entertaining space features a fireplace and built-in wet bar. Partial room divisions create cozy areas for lounging and games while maintaining an easy flow. The garage provides tandem parking for 2 cars, laundry, abundant storage, and a bonus bath. A gated driveway from the rear alley offers additional off-street parking. Stern Grove's wooded paths are just down the block. Stonestown Galleria offers extensive shopping, dining, and a Sunday farmers market, while West Portal's neighborhood shops, cafes, and restaurants are also nearby. Sloat Boulevard leads to the ocean, while Portola Drive connects to Market Street. Nearby schools include Lowell High School, Lakeshore Elementary, St. Stephen School, West Portal Lutheran School, and San Francisco State University. Buses and Muni stops are mere blocks away servicing SF broadly, and nearby 19th Avenue connects to I-280.

Welcome to 1328 Visitacion Ave, a beautifully remodeled two (2) bedroom and two (2) full bath home with over 1400 square feet of living space, renovated from the floors to the ceilings, including but not limited to new bathrooms, kitchen and more. Every upgrade was chosen with the next owner in minnd, so the home is truly move-in ready the day you get the keys. The freshly landscaped backyard is ready for your vision, whether that's a garden, a play area or a place to entertain. Enjoy city views from a residential street in Visitacion Valley, a part of San Francisco known for sunnier weather than foggier neighborhoods. Just minutes away is John McLaren Park, the city's second-largest park at more than 300 acres, with trails, playgrounds and open space. Nearby Leland Avenue offers cafes, restaurants and local shops, and the Visitacion Valey Greenway's garden paths run through the neighborhood. Commuting is easy, with quick access to Highway 101, the Bayshore Caltrain Station, and T-Third Muni light rail and nearby bus lines. Close to schools, shopping and everything San Francisco has to offer, including world class dining, culture and entertainment. Come see why this could be the perfect place to call home.

First time on the market in generations, this classic 1920s home presents an exceptional opportunity for contractors, builders, or buyers looking to get a foothold in the SF housing market. Situated on a large lot with room to expand, this 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence is ready for upgrades and offers tremendous potential. BRING YOUR CONTRACTORS! The main level was expanded with a permit that has since expired. The lower level also features multiple storage rooms, parking, and interior access to the main level. A level, generously sized rear yard enhances the home. Conveniently located near Ocean Avenue, neighborhood parks, Muni, and freeway access. Call today to see this Excellent Value.

Behind the house, a lush, one-of-a-kind garden designed by Flora Grubb Gardens unfolds around monumental stones and gently splashing fountains, leading to a sunken spa. Coffee is on the bistro deck. Afternoons belong to the flagstone terrace. When dusk arrives, the garden lights turn the whole scene into something that feels, quite honestly, like a dream. A fireplace anchors the foyer. The dining room is all box-beam ceiling, picture rail, and glass-front china cabinet, a room that yearns to host. The kitchen pairs stainless steel counters with updated appliances. Two bedrooms share the main level with a bath built around a freestanding soaking tub, and a flex room off the foyer, fitted with built-in shelving and cabinetry, can be a pantry, a craft room, or the place where projects live. Refinished hardwood floors, fresh interior and exterior paint, and new lighting run throughout. The top-floor rooms feels tucked away on purpose. Bookcases are fitted beneath the eaves, and the dressing has a window seat with views of the garden. A sitting area, separate office, and private bath make the floor a retreat of its own. Accessed from the street and the garden, the approximately 1,160-square-foot garage level offers two-car parking, a workshop, storage, and laundry. It also offers development potential, subject to buyer verification, which gives the future you plenty to think about. The garden spirit doesn't stop at the property line. Neighbors tend the hillside plantings along the block, and a community mural is on the way. The shops and cafs of 24th Street are a few blocks away. On Saturdays, the farmers market at Noe Valley Town Square makes an easy weekend ritual, and the Diamond Street stairs lead the way toward the Castro.

This sophisticated, fully renovated Noe Valley residence is a complete standout! Wrapped in opulent finishes and boasting over 1,600 square feet, it envelops you with all the feelings you want when you walk into your new home - it's luxurious, spacious, and elegant. The light-filled living space offers a formal living room with an original brick fireplace for cozy nights by the fire and a true formal dining room for dinner parties for 10-12. The two designer bedrooms each boast their own private en-suite bath - a rarity at this price point. The primary suite is a true retreat, opening to a sun-drenched bonus flex room that works as a lounge, office, nursery or morning hideaway, with a spa-like bath with Zia tile, a soaking tub and Phylrich fittings. The second suite stands on its own, with a bath wrapped in pistachio Edward Martin tile. A stylish powder room keeps visitors enthralled with its sexy wallpaper and Nood Co sink - imported from Australia. The kitchen is made for cooking and entertaining, with custom Good Wood cabinetry, honed Australian Dream dolomite counters, a Miele oven and induction cooktop, a Fisher & Paykel refrigerator with a separate freezer, and a designer dishwasher, all on new oak floors. New Marvin Elevate windows and mineral wool insulation keep the home quiet and efficient. Wired for Ethernet, so you never have to worry about staying connected. Step outside to a shared yard for morning coffee, gardening, or evenings in the Noe Valley sunshine. There is also a one-car parking spot in the garage and laundry. You're moments from the Church & 24th Street cafes, boutique shopping, craft cocktail bars, and the J-Church and tech shuttles. This home really has it all!

Discover a refined take on San Francisco living at 1582 45th Ave, where contemporary comfort meets the relaxed charm of the Outer Sunset. Thoughtfully renovated throughout, this inviting home features 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths upstairs, with the living room, kitchen and a half bath conveniently situated on the main level for effortless everyday living and entertaining. Extensive upgrades include brand-new electrical and plumbing systems, a new roof, new windows, and new appliances. Radiant floor heating and high ceilings enhance the home's comfort and sense of space, while a luxurious primary bathroom offers a spa-inspired retreat. A bonus office provides flexibility for working from home, and the cozy backyard creates a welcoming setting to relax or entertain. Ideally located near Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach, this home offers easy access to scenic outdoor escapes, neighborhood cafs, local shops, restaurants, public transportation, and highly regarded neighborhood schools. Combining extensive upgrades, versatile living spaces, and a sought-after coastal setting, this is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the best of San Francisco living.

Westwood Park Single Family with massive lot. Classic 1920s Spanish Revival on a generous lot with generous front and back yards. Five bedrooms, two baths, one-car garage with driveway parking, original gumwood, hardwood floors, coved ceilings. Living room with fireplace, formal dining with gumwood, and a breakfast room overlooking the backyard, great for morning coffee. Refreshed kitchen with new countertops, refrigerator, dishwasher, plus pantry and laundry with backyard access. Main level bedroom with diret access to the full bath, two more bedrooms finish out this level. Upstairs, two bedrooms and a second full bath with Heath tile, plus access to the upstairs bath from one of the bedrooms allowing for flexible layout for a second primary. Fenced backyard with mature plantings, patio areas, and space to relax. Convenient to Ocean Avenue, Muni, BART, City College, Stonestown, and I-280.

In every neighborhood there's a block that is the one'' that makes you want to move there immediately. Unfortunately, there are only so many homes on that block. Fortunately, 17 Bennington's cheery faade, sheltered by a front garden is ready to welcome you home. Originally built in the aftermath of the 1906 earthquake, and substantially renovated 100 years later since 2006, this home is ready for modern life. With 9 useful rooms in total, there's space for music, home offices, workshops and privacy, while the large double parlor and kitchen/dining room make space for life together too. The creativity that can come from having the right space cannot be underestimated - one current owner is a sculptor and musician and the other is locally famous for her lego machines that automatically hand out candy on Halloween. What will you do here? If that's kick back on the deck with friends that's fine, but you might just find yourself inspired The home has the perfect floorplan too. Main level has one bedroom, one bath, double parlor, spacious kitchen/dining room that flows to the rear garden. Upstairs there's a primary with a bath, a full bath and a third bedroom. Downstairs there is a fourth bedroom, storage/laundry and a music room/office and direct access to the garage with parking for one smaller car.

Perched on a Bernal Heights corner with sweeping views of downtown and the Bay, 85 Montcalm Street is the kind of home San Francisco seldom offers. Built in 1965 and filled with natural light, its approx. 1,954 sq. ft. (per graphic artist) unfold across a gracious 5-bed, 3-bath plan, ready to enjoy as is or shape to your own vision. On the main level, broad picture windows frame the skyline from the living room, where parquet floors and a decorative fireplace lend mid-century warmth. The dining room shares the panorama and flows into a generously proportioned kitchen. Three bedrooms and 2 baths complete the level, including a primary suite with a dressing hall of dual closets and a skylit en-suite bath, plus a second skylit bath. Below, 2 additional bedrooms and a full bath create a quiet retreat for guests or a home office. A side-by-side 2-car garage, a true rarity in the city, offers interior access, laundry, storage, and access to a rear garden with mature trees. Walk Score 89, moments from Cortland Avenue, with 24th Street BART a 19-minute walk, Muni 49 nearby, and easy access to US-101 and I-280.

Located on the desirable northwest slope of Bernal Heights, 51 Prospect is a charming 1909 home offering a peaceful retreat from the city, with unobstructed views toward Twin Peaks and the San Francisco skyline. Set back from a quiet, tree-lined street, the home has an intimate, welcoming character, a private garden, and flexible living spaces, all within easy reach of the neighborhood's favorite destinations. The main level is bathed in natural light which highlights the rich wood floors of the main living space, while French doors open to the primary bedroom. A built-in window bench beneath the front windows creates a cozy spot for reading or morning coffee. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances and generous cabinetry, while the second bedroom overlooks the garden and boasts ample closet space. A thoughtfully updated bathroom includes a double vanity, shower-over-tub combination & radiant floor heating, complemented by a convenient laundry closet with side-by-side washer and dryer. Just off the main living level, the secluded garden feels like a natural extension of the living space. A wood pergola shades the stone patio, creating an inviting setting for alfresco dining, quiet afternoons, or gatherings with friends. Raised planting beds and a fountain lend the outdoor space a charming, intimate atmosphere. Upstairs, the finished attic offers a versatile retreat for a home office, creative studio, or occasional guests, complete with a half bath. A one-car garage and full basement provide abundant storage and practical flexibility. With a Walk Score of 92, the location strikes an appealing balance between neighborhood charm and urban convenience. The cafs, restaurants, and independent shops of Cortland Avenue and Precita Park are just blocks away, while nearby Bernal Heights Park offers scenic trails and panoramic city views. Easy access to Highways 101 and 280 makes commuting throughout San Francisco and down the Peninsula equally convenient.

Imagine enjoying your morning coffee on your private balcony while taking in beautiful views of the Bay Bridge and San Francisco skyline. Tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac in the desirable India Basin neighborhood, this charming two-level home offers approximately 1,275 sq. ft. of comfortable living space, featuring 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and an open floor plan. Enjoy indoor-outdoor living with a private deck and lower patio, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, along with an attached one-car garage and washer/dryer area on the second level. Conveniently located near the Third Street light rail, India Basin waterfront, parks, restaurants, the Shipyard development, and easy access to Highways 101 and 280, with Chase Center and Oracle Park just a short drive away. With its peaceful setting, beautiful city views, and low HOA dues, 38 Rebecca Lane is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy homeownership in San Francisco and make a special place your own. Come see all the possibilities!

Modern farmhouse charm meets San Francisco history at 30 Niantic Avenue! Next door to H-Mart, just 0.3 miles from Daly City BART and moments from I-280 via Alemany Boulevard, this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom single-family home offers an easy commute to the Peninsula, and the South Bay. Filled with natural light and character, the upper level features a kitchen with gas range, mud room/pantry with Saltillo tiles, dining area, bedroom, and bath with a classic clawfoot tub. Downstairs, enjoy a spacious family room, second bedroom, full bath with Saltillo-tiles and travertine tile shower with fossils, and laundry. The home's unique heritage includes two original 1908 Type A Earthquake Relief Cottages, preserved and elevated during a 2003 expansion. Outside, a lush, fully fenced backyard offers space to entertain, garden, or unwind. Double gates from the paved rear road allow for off-street parking for a boat, camper, or vehicles, with an additional parking pad outside the gate. As an added benefit to the buyer, the seller plans to install a new composition-shingle roof overlay, subject to required permits, in the coming weeks. Historic character, modern comfort, flexible parking, and exceptional connectivity - all in Ingleside Heights, also known as the Merced Extension Triangle.
